title: Sowing Against the Storm
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he reveals the miracle-working power of faith in the midst of impossible circumstances. Drawing from the story of Isaac, Pastor Zehner shows how to operate in the opposite spirit of what's coming against you and reap a harvest of blessings beyond measure. Don't miss this powerful message of hope and encouragement as Pastor Zehner declares that God is about to flip your situation in your favor.
